items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Florence Mills was too. Oh yeah? Yes, wait a minute. Florence Mills, Cora Green, and my aunt. There were three women singing there.

ctx.x: It's Chicago. And I don't know this- DeCochran, the same one that booked Florence Mills. Yeah. He booked this to Europe. So- We're off at DeCochran.
What were the different acts in that show? I joined in Foster, was one.
